name: splashwater-videomasking
blurb: Video masked with splash-center SVG creating water splash reveal effect.
description: An autoplay video masked with an SVG splash shape (splash-center.svg from public folder). Creates artistic water splash reveal effect via CSS mask-image, mask-size, and mask-position.
use_when: Hero sections or visual content blocks needing artistic water splash video effects.
avoid_when: When splash-center.svg asset is unavailable in public folder; missing mask makes video fully invisible.
a11y: Autoplay video without user control or captions; decorative masking makes content inaccessible if mask asset missing.
